milne_hasse_norm.author: J. S. Milne
milne_hasse_norm.title: Class Field Theory
milne_hasse_norm.locator: Chapter VIII, Section 3, Theorem 3.1 (Hasse norm theorem)
milne_hasse_norm.used_for: For a cyclic number-field extension, an element that is a norm at every completion is a global norm. Applied only to the quadratic extension F(i)/F.

shnidman_siad.title: Hecke reciprocity and class groups
shnidman_siad.used_for: Checked whether Hecke reciprocity can constrain Cl(O_F)[2]. It does not in this field because the Hecke ideal has no odd-valuation prime.

pari.used_for: A future bnfcertify(B,1)=1 proves the true class group is a quotient of the computed class group. Thus, if the computed class group has odd order, this weaker unconditional certificate is already enough to prove d=dim_F2 Cl(O_F)[2]=0. No successful PARI class-group run was obtained in U80.

upstream_U78.used_for: Integral basis/discriminant, prime decomposition, V=ker norm, local dimensions, W_17=0, real H_v=0, and good-place unramified local conditions.

upstream_U79.used_for: Exact basis of W_2 by 1+s^n and 1+phi*s^n for odd n=19,...,33 and the s^35 squareclass cutoff.
